disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 在全部源码与脚本中查找了宿主凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、.ssh、id_rsa、云厂商凭据）的读取与枚举逻辑：插件只读写自己工作区下的团队状态文件（team.json 与 inbox 邮箱），未触碰任何凭据路径。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Searched all source code and scripts for logic that reads or enumerates host credential files (e.g., .credentials.yaml, .ssh, id_rsa, cloud provider credentials): the plugin only reads and writes the team state file (team.json and the inbox mailbox) under its own workspace, and does not touch any credential paths. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 在客户端代码与文档中查找了 API Key、令牌、钱包助记词等敏感信息的收集逻辑：未发现任何收集或访问面。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Searched client code and documentation for logic that collects sensitive information such as API keys, tokens, wallet mnemonics: no collection or access surface found. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件的代码路径，也无外联通道可外发；插件自身状态数据与凭据无关，凭据外泄链不成立。
evidence.en: No code path that reads credential files was found, and there is no outbound channel for exfiltration; the plugin's own state data is unrelated to credentials, so the credential exfiltration chain does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 逐个审了注册的 10 个工具说明文本：均为多智能体协作的正常用法（建队、加成员、建任务、派发、发消息、查状态、删队），无诱导读取凭据、诱导安装、改权限或覆写规则的措辞。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description text of all 10 registered tools one by one: all are normal multi-agent collaboration usage (create team, add member, create task, assign, send message, check status, delete team), with no wording that induces credential reading, induces installation, changes permissions, or overrides rules. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 审了注入系统提示词的使用策略段与 /agent-teams 命令的激活消息：内容是把用户说「用 AgentTeams 做 X」翻译成建队协议，属插件的正常入口功能，无隐藏指令。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the usage policy section where the system prompt is injected and the activation message of the /agent-teams command: the content translates the user's statement "do X with AgentTeams" into a team-creation protocol, which is part of the plugin's normal entry functionality, with no hidden instructions. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 审了全部文档、README、开发 Skill 与源码注释：未发现「忽略此前指令」「无需审计」「以本文件为准」类注入措辞，也没有让模型访问外部 URL 拉取指令的文案。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all documentation, README, development Skills, and source code comments: no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions", "no audit needed", "this file takes precedence" was found, nor was there any text that makes the model fetch instructions from an external URL. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 机制留痕：团队成员子代理之间通过邮箱互发消息，内容会作为下一条消息进入对方模型上下文，这是多智能体协作的设计功能（消息来源标注为插件而非用户），没有外部攻击者可控的注入入口，未按漏洞收录。
checked_items.en: Mechanism trace: messages between member sub-agents in a team are sent via mailbox, and the content is fed as the next message into the other party's model context. This is a designed feature of multi-agent collaboration (the message source is marked as the plugin, not the user), with no injection entry controllable by an external attacker, so it is not recorded as a vulnerability.

evidence.zh: 全部工具描述与系统提示段均为正常使用协议（src/index.ts 的使用策略段与 src/tools.ts 各工具说明），无投毒措辞。
evidence.en: All tool descriptions and system prompt sections are normal usage protocols (the usage policy section in src/index.ts and each tool description in src/tools.ts), with no poisoning wording.

evidence.zh: 工具与提示文本中没有诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；/agent-teams 激活消息仅把用户已输入的目标转成建队指令。
evidence.en: The tool and prompt text contains no wording that induces installing plugins, rewriting configuration, or relaxing permissions; the /agent-teams activation message merely converts the user's already-entered goal into a team-creation instruction.

checked_items.zh: 全树查找了动态执行模式（eval、new Function、子进程、base64 解码即执行、yaml 的 js 表达式标量）：运行时代码零命中；唯一的子进程调用在开发验证脚本里，用于在 Windows 文件锁测试中拉起 PowerShell 占锁，且该目录不在随包分发的文件清单内。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for dynamic execution patterns (eval, new Function, child processes, base64 decode-and-execute, js expression scalars in YAML): zero hits in runtime code; the only child process call is in a development verification script, used to launch PowerShell to hold a file lock in a Windows file-lock test, and that directory is not in the file list shipped with the package. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 通读了挂载补丁全文：只有一行插件声明与两项配置，无任何可执行表达式，也没有覆盖安全配置或禁用审批、沙箱的写法。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Read the entire patch (cordis.patch.yml): it contains only a plugin declaration line and two configuration items, with no executable expression and no writing that overrides security configuration or disables approval or sandbox. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 核对了安装钩子（preinstall、install、postinstall、prepare）：package.json 中均不存在；prepublishOnly 只做构建与验证，属发布流程。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked the install hooks (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare): none exist in package.json; prepublishOnly only does build and verification, which is part of the publish flow. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 对客户端 bundle 做了专项检查：声明的键盘监听只响应 Escape 键（取消任务固定），未发现按键记录、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC 调用。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Conducted a dedicated check on the client bundle: the declared keyboard listener only responds to the Escape key (to cancel task pinning); no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential RPC calls were found. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件无 !!js 表达式标量，不会触发挂载期代码执行（cordis.patch.yml 全文仅一行 insert）。
evidence.en: The patch file has no !!js expression scalars and will not trigger code execution at patch time (the entire cordis.patch.yml is a single insert line).

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis_define、cordis_run 等动态包工具，无让模型在宿主执行代码的面。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tools such as cordis_define or cordis_run are called, so there is no surface for the model to execute code on the host.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子、无 git 依赖可变引用（以 npm 包发布）、快照内无树内执行载体（.github 目录未随包分发）。
evidence.en: No install hooks, no mutable git dependency references (published as an npm package), and no in-tree execution carrier in the snapshot (the .github directory is not shipped with the package).

evidence.zh: 客户端 bundle 只做同源轮询本机状态路由与面板 UI 交互，无键盘记录、剪贴板或凭证 RPC 等危险浏览器行为。
evidence.en: The client bundle only performs same-origin polling of the local status route and panel UI interaction, with no dangerous browser behaviors such as keylogging, clipboard access, or credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 全树查找了外联通道（外部 http 请求、WebSocket、隧道、命令行 curl/wget）：运行时代码唯一的网络调用是浏览器面板同源轮询本机状态路由，无外部域名、无裸 IP、无带外通道。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Searched the entire tree for outbound channels (external http requests, WebSocket, tunnels, command-line curl/wget): the only network call in runtime code is same-origin polling of the local status route from the browser panel, with no external domains, no raw IPs, and no out-of-band channels. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 文档与脚本中的 curl 命令均为面向 127.0.0.1 本地实例的手工验证步骤，不是插件运行代码。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: The curl commands in documentation and scripts are manual verification steps targeting the local 127.0.0.1 instance, not plugin runtime code. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 服务器端注册的两条 Web 路由只返回本插件团队状态 JSON 与打包图片（图片带文件名白名单防目录穿越），没有任何出站请求。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: The two web routes registered on the server side only return the plugin's team state JSON and packaged images (the image route has a filename whitelist to prevent directory traversal), with no outbound requests. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 外联侧无任何出站通道（唯一网络调用为同源本机状态轮询），与 DG-D1 读取侧结合，外泄链不成立。
evidence.en: On the outbound side there is no outbound channel at all (the only network call is same-origin local status polling); combined with the read side of DG-D1, the exfiltration chain does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 核对了全部依赖：peer 与开发依赖均为 deepseek-ai 官方宿主 SDK 和常见构建工具（react、typescript、tsdown 等），无来历不明或同名抢注嫌疑的包。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked all dependencies: peer and dev dependencies are all from the deepseek-ai official host SDK and common build tools (react, typescript, tsdown, etc.), with no packages of unknown origin or suspected name-squatting. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 核对了作者、仓库与包名：三者一致，首版审计无版本基线可比较历史改写。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked author, repository, and package name: all three are consistent, and as a first-version audit there is no prior version baseline to compare for historical tampering. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 核对了补丁与事件监听面：补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全项；未发现对审批链事件的高优先级监听。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch and event listener surface: the patch does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and does not disable any security item; no high-priority listeners on approval-chain events were found. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁只有 insert 声明行，不覆盖任何安全配置行，也无 disabled、环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch contains only an insert declaration line, does not override any security configuration line, and has no disabled flag or environment-variable privilege-lowering writing.

evidence.zh: 未监听审批链、工具预执行等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的监听者。
evidence.en: No listeners on security events such as the approval chain or tool pre-execution; there is no listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无上一版本基线，无法比较 manifest 声明是否突变，本项不适用。
evidence.en: As a first-version audit, there is no previous version baseline, so whether the manifest declarations have changed cannot be compared; this item is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会给安全插件追加不存在的服务。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration and will not add non-existent services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 审查了服务器端两条 Web 路由：状态路由只读团队目录返回 JSON，图片路由有文件名白名单，均无目录穿越与越权写盘。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the two server-side web routes: the status route is read-only over the team directory and returns JSON, and the image route has a filename whitelist; neither has directory traversal or unauthorized disk writes. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 宿主 API 改写留痕：插件包装了子代理服务的消息投递方法，给已退役成员加拦截，用完即恢复原方法，属良性护栏而非劫持。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Host API rewrite trace: the plugin wraps the message delivery method of the sub-agent service to add an interceptor for retired members, and restores the original method after use; this is a benign guardrail rather than hijacking. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 生态固有风险标注：插件复用宿主 Web 服务器注册路由，未自行监听端口；宿主 Web 服务无认证层属生态固有风险（DG-S10），非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Ecosystem inherent risk annotation: the plugin reuses the host web server to register routes and does not listen on its own port; the host web service lacking an authentication layer is an ecosystem inherent risk (DG-S10), not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件不自建 Web 服务、不监听端口，只向宿主 Web 服务器注册两条路由；宿主无认证属生态固有风险，不是插件问题，故本项不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not build its own web service or listen on a port; it only registers two routes on the host web server. The host lacking authentication is an ecosystem inherent risk, not a plugin issue, so this item is not applicable.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：package.json 含 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明，作者、仓库、包名一致，无名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: package.json contains dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations, author, repository, and package name are consistent, with no name impersonation or identity anomalies.

summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与系统提示段均为正常多智能体协作协议，声明能力与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and system prompt sections are normal multi-agent collaboration protocols, and declared capabilities match actual measurements.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（上下文目录无动态沙盒产物）。

limits.en:
Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not enabled: no dynamic sandbox artifacts in the context directory, and no runtime behavior verification was performed.

The 15 static pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one: DSH-X07 (.github/workflows/publish.yml, mapped to DG-R3-59) — this file is not in the current snapshot (the tarball does not include the .github directory), so no evidence can be collected; excluded. DSH-T02 (mapped to DG-R2-52) has 4 entries (docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:194, docs/readme-writing-guide.md:39, docs/usage.md:16, src/index.ts:134) — all are registrations or explanations of system prompt sections, with normal usage policy content and no injection intent; excluded. DSH-C05 (mapped to DG-R4-53) has 8 entries (docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:601, docs/verification-guide.md:162, 163, 176, 184, 185, 186, 236) — all are manual verification commands pointing to the local 127.0.0.1 instance, which are documentation rather than runtime code; excluded. DSH-X03 (scripts/verify.mjs:1098, mapped to DG-R3-55) — a child process call in the development verification script that launches PowerShell on Windows to hold a lock for testing atomic writes; the scripts directory is not in the file list shipped with the package; excluded. DSH-X05 (src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:320, mapped to DG-R3-57) — the React panel keyboard listener only handles the Escape key to cancel task pinning, with no keylogging, clipboard, or credential RPC; excluded.

The dsh engine version is not explicitly declared in the manifest; engines.dsh and the marketplace compatibility table are inferred from peerDependencies as >=0.1.0-rc.6, without testing against a corresponding host version; pnpm-lock.yaml was not read verbatim (only the dependency declaration surface was checked).
